originalTitle: US stocks today: Nasdaq lags on angst over AI spending ahead of earnings reports
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: the Nasdaq, which is a group of technology stocks, went down today because some investors are worried that companies are spending too much money on artificial intelligence (AI). On the other hand, the Dow, which is another group of stocks, went up, and the S&P 500, a broader group of stocks, stayed about the same. This mix of ups and downs happened even though oil prices fell, which is usually a good thing for the market. The market is also being cautious because some big tech companies are about to release their earnings reports, which can be important for investors. Overall, investors are being careful and watching to see what happens next.

originalTitle: American Express Q2 profit rises driven by higher spending and fewer delinquencies
simplifiedContent: American Express made 8% more profit in the second quarter compared to last year, which is a good sign for the company. This increase in profit is mainly due to people using their American Express cards more and also paying their bills on time, which reduces the number of late payments. The company also got more new customers to sign up for its high-end services, which shows that its marketing efforts are working. However, the company did spend 12% more on things like advertising and improving its products, which is a lot, but it's an investment in the company's future growth. This news matters because it shows that American Express is doing well and is investing in its business to continue growing.

originalTitle: ACC Q1 Results: Profit plunges 60% to Rs 147 crore on lower sales
simplifiedContent: ACC Ltd, a company owned by the Adani Group, just released its quarterly results and they're not great. The company's profit decreased by 60.8% to Rs 147 crore, which is a big drop. This happened because the company sold fewer products, which led to a 7.75% decrease in the money it made. Higher costs also hurt the company's earnings, but on a positive note, its premium products are doing well and gaining market share. This decline in profit matters because it can affect the company's stock price and investor confidence.

originalTitle: Mint Explainer| Will Sebi's proposed changes lift the portfolio management industry?
simplifiedContent: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has suggested some changes that might help the portfolio management industry grow. These changes could encourage existing investors to put more money into their investments and also attract new investors who think the new options will be profitable. This is important because it could bring more money into the industry, which could help it expand. The proposed changes are expected to make the products more appealing to investors, which is why it's likely to have a positive impact. Overall, Sebi's proposals might lead to more investment and growth in the portfolio management industry.

originalTitle: Yields ease, but Iran war keeps rate-hike bets alive
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news: The yields on US government bonds, also known as Treasuries, have decreased a bit. Despite this decrease, there's still a chance that interest rates might go up soon. This is because of the ongoing conflict with Iran, which is making investors think that the US might raise interest rates. The possibility of a rate hike is still being considered, even with the current decrease in yields. This matters because changes in interest rates can affect the overall economy and the stock market.

originalTitle: Yen records biggest weekly drop in over two months, dollar climbs for the week
simplifiedContent: The Japanese yen had its biggest weekly loss in over two months, meaning its value decreased significantly compared to other currencies. At the same time, the US dollar increased in value over the week. This change in currency values is important because it can affect international trade and the prices of goods. The drop in the yen's value and the rise in the dollar's value can also impact investments and the overall economy. This shift in currency values is a notable event in the foreign exchange market, which is where people trade different currencies.
